cohort: 923 outborn neonates admitted to a tertiary care hospital's NICU between April 2023 and March 2025.
finding: The MSNS is a reliable tool for predicting mortality in outborn neonates, with an optimal cut-off score of <=12 demonstrating high sensitivity (86.1%), specificity (78.3%), and negative predictive value (92.4%).
followup_time: duration of NICU stay within the study period (April 2023 to March 2025)
